cause: The existing real-artifact test test_locked_oos_requires_explicit_capability called query(LOCKED_OOS, allow_locked=True). It ran during full test suites before the bypass was identified.
access_scope: The Parquet reader opened the actual LOCKED_OOS file before taking head(1); the test asserted only the partition string. Legacy checksum verification and replay also accessed VALIDATION.
remediation: ParquetExperienceStore now rejects LOCKED_OOS regardless of allow_locked
Default checksum verification and replay are DEV-only
The legacy positive-access test now asserts denial
future_holdout_use: Review this access incident before claiming the holdout has never been opened; do not silently erase this record.
